page.notes: Greek passages (Hesychius, Aristophanes' Nebulae, the Ἀπονενοημένος entry) are transcribed from the scan and not checked against an edition; several accents and letters are uncertain and should be verified. The line "Δα. Καὶ ταῦτ'" and the Ba./Ca. speaker lines are uncertain in their Greek and Latin letters. "Pacuuius" is kept as Pacvvius per the u/v rule. Printed "confultis" and "scelefte" are kept as printed. The opening Greek word of the paragraph "Οἱ ὀμόσαι" and the final Greek word "Παναθηναϊκῶ" are partly illegible. The line "Athenis qui facile..." may begin a new paragraph; here it is kept joined to the preceding speech because it runs on from a full line without an indent.
